title: Funded Startup Lead Pipeline Input
description: Turn recent SEC Form D private fundraises into enriched B2B leads. Pay per scored lead.

maxAgeDays.title: Filing lookback (days)
maxAgeDays.description: How far back to pull Form D filings. Default 30 days catches the freshest raises.

minAmountSoldUsd.title: Minimum amount sold (USD)
minAmountSoldUsd.description: Only keep raises where at least this much has been sold. Zero keeps every operating-company filing.

states.title: Issuer states
states.description: Two-letter state codes to include (e.g. CA, NY, TX). Empty includes every state.

includeFunds.title: Include investment funds
includeFunds.description: Off by default. When off, pooled investment funds and SPVs are dropped so leads are operating companies. Turn on to include fund vehicles.

includeContacts.title: Enrich with contacts
includeContacts.description: Look up each top lead on Google Maps for a website and phone, then scrape contact emails from the site. Turn off for funding data only.

maxLeads.title: Max leads
maxLeads.description: Cap total leads scored per run, ranked by amount raised.

maxContactLookups.title: Max contact lookups
maxContactLookups.description: Cap how many of the top leads get the Google Maps + email enrichment, to bound run time and cost.

userAgent.title: User-Agent (with email)
userAgent.description: SEC EDGAR requires a User-Agent containing a contact email. Example: 'yourname research@yourdomain.com'. Leave blank to use a default.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy, passed through to the Google Maps child. EDGAR is called directly and does not need a proxy.
